title: I Tap the Tin Pot
lines: I am Tim. A tin pot is on top.
I tap it. Tap, tap, tap.
Pop! The pot is not on top.
The pot is on the mat.
I mop it. Mop, mop, mop.
The mat is tan. The pot is on top.
I sit and sip. I nap.

questions.ask: What happened after Tim tapped the pot?
questions.listenFor: It went pop and it landed on the mat. Lines three and four tell it together, so let them read both.
Tim did, on his own. Listen for Tim and not a grown-up - that is the whole point of the story.

questions.ask: Tell me about a time you cleaned up something you knocked over.
questions.listenFor: Any answer is fine. You are listening for them tying the story to something of their own.
